43:   numbers, commit SHAs, run IDs, dataset names, and model IDs. Never
44:   round, never paraphrase a quantitative value.

69:## §4. Hook designs — FULL AUTOMATION (mechanical-enforcement)
70:
71:### Design 1 — AUTO-COMPACT-VIA-HOOK (Rank #3 upgrade: operator-discipline → mechanical gate)
72:
73:**Trigger event**: `UserPromptSubmit` (fires on every turn, has stdout→additionalContext routing)
74:
75:**Mechanism**: hook reads transcript token-count + emits `additionalContext` warning at thresholds AND auto-fires `/compact <hint>` when ≥250K threshold crossed.
76:
77:**Per Anthropic CC §UserPromptSubmit** + §Add context for Claude: stdout becomes additionalContext alongside the user's submitted prompt. The hook CANNOT directly execute `/compact` (slash commands are user-side), but it CAN emit a `systemMessage` warning + suggest the operator type `/compact <hint>` OR (more aggressive) emit `decision: "block"` with reason="auto-compact threshold reached — type /compact <focused-hint> first" which erases the current prompt and forces operator action.
78:
79:**Two options** (per advanced-agent-team-standing-directive ≥2-option mandate):
80:
81:**Option A — Advisory `systemMessage` (non-blocking)**
82:
83:```python
84:#!/usr/bin/env python3
85:# auto_compact_advisory.py — UserPromptSubmit hook
86:# Emits systemMessage warning at 250k / 300k / 350k thresholds; never blocks
87:# Reference: Anthropic CC https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks §UserPromptSubmit
88:# Reference: auto-compact-discipline.md Rank #3 operator-discipline upgrade
89:import json, sys, os, pathlib
90:
91:THRESHOLDS = [(350_000, "CRITICAL"), (300_000, "HIGH"), (250_000, "WARN")]
92:payload = json.loads(sys.stdin.read() or "{}")
93:transcript_path = pathlib.Path(payload.get("transcript_path", ""))
94:
95:if not transcript_path.exists():
96:    sys.exit(0)  # advisory fail-open
97:
98:# Conservative token estimate: chars/4 (per repos/deps cnighswonger cache-fix derivation 3.99 chars/token)
99:try:
100:    chars = transcript_path.stat().st_size
101:    tokens = chars // 4
102:except Exception:
103:    sys.exit(0)
104:
105:for thresh, sev in THRESHOLDS:
106:    if tokens >= thresh:
107:        msg = f"AUTO-COMPACT-ADVISORY {sev}: transcript ~{tokens:,} tokens. Type `/compact focus on <active-task>` BEFORE auto-compact fires."
108:        out = {"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": msg}, "systemMessage": msg}
109:        print(json.dumps(out))
110:        sys.exit(0)
111:sys.exit(0)
112:```
113:
114:**Cite anchor**: Anthropic CC `https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#userpromptsubmit` [VERIFIED 2026-05-13 via ctx_fetch_and_index] + `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` field per §UserPromptSubmit + 10K cap per §Add context for Claude.
115:
116:**Option B — Hard block via `decision: "block"` (mechanical-enforcement at 350K critical threshold)**
117:
118:```python
119:# Same shape but at 350K critical:
120:out = {"decision": "block", "reason": f"AUTO-COMPACT-CRITICAL: transcript ~{tokens:,} tokens — type /compact <focused-hint> FIRST"}
121:```
122:
123:Per Anthropic CC: "`decision: 'block'` prevents the prompt from being processed and erases it from context" — operator must type `/compact <hint>` then retry. This is the **mechanical-gate-enforced** form of auto-compact-discipline.md Rank #3.
124:
125:**Option C — Hybrid (recommended; Option A at WARN+HIGH, Option B at CRITICAL)**
126:
127:Activate Option A advisories at 250K/300K (operator can choose); escalate to Option B hard-block at 350K (mechanical-enforcement). Matches `Z:/claude-sota/.claude/rules/closed-loop-recursive-narrowing.md §Outcome A monotone-decline` pattern — graduated severity with explicit override gate.
128:
129:**Wire**: `.claude/settings.json` `hooks.UserPromptSubmit` entry; async=false (synchronous since stdout must arrive before prompt processes); timeout=5000ms.
130:
131:**Cite anchor**: TIER-1-DIRECT Anthropic CC `https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#userpromptsubmit` 2026-05-13 + `auto-compact-discipline.md` Rank #3 (TIER-3-LOCAL-COMPOSITION sibling) + `closed-loop-recursive-narrowing.md §Outcome A` graduated-severity pattern.
132:
133:---
134:
135:### Design 2 — SESSIONSTART-PRELOAD-VERIFY hook (W168 Spec 3 fulfillment)
136:
137:**Trigger event**: `SessionStart` (matchers `startup` / `resume` / `clear` / **`compact`** — last is post-auto-compact rehydrate channel)
138:
139:**Mechanism**: 3-layer Karpathy §5 preload + 5-backend hash verify + emit STALE-PRELOAD-NOTICE via stderr→system-reminder on refute.
140:
141:```python
142:#!/usr/bin/env python3
143:# sessionstart_preload_verify.py — SessionStart hook (all matchers)
144:# 3-layer Karpathy §5 preload + 5-backend hash verify
145:# Reference: Anthropic CC https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#sessionstart
146:# Reference: Karpathy §5 Wiki Compounding Surface at karpathy-adapted.md §5
147:# Reference: fm20-path-drift-cascade.md row 9 asymmetric-dual-write defense
148:import json, sys, os, hashlib, subprocess, pathlib
149:
150:ROOT = pathlib.Path("Z:/claude-sota-installed")
151:MEMORY = ROOT / ".claude/projects/Z--claude-sota-installed/memory/MEMORY.md"
152:STATE = ROOT / ".claude/state"
153:TMP = ROOT / "tmp"
154:
155:payload = json.loads(sys.stdin.read() or "{}")
156:matcher = payload.get("matcher", "startup")  # startup/resume/clear/compact
157:session_id = payload.get("session_id", "")
158:
159:# Layer 2 — MEMORY.md ceiling probe (Karpathy §5)
160:mem_lines = MEMORY.read_text(encoding="utf-8").count("\n") if MEMORY.exists() else 0
161:mem_status = "OK" if mem_lines <= 200 else f"OVER-CEILING ({mem_lines} > 200; archive trigger)"
162:
163:# Layer 3 — last-3 close-synthesis available?
164:recent_synth = sorted(TMP.glob("wave*-close-synthesis-*.md"), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True)[:3]
165:synth_status = "OK" if len(recent_synth) >= 1 else "EMPTY"
166:
167:# Layer 1 — JSONL tail probe (mechanical enforcement evidence)
168:codex_verdicts = list((STATE).glob("codex_review_HEAD_*.txt"))
169:verdict_count = len(codex_verdicts)
